source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What is the role of a skill's scripts/ folder?

options.text: Holding prose about when to select the skill
options.feedback: Selection guidance belongs in SKILL.md and its description. Scripts provide executable operations.
A skill can include executable routines for operations such as extraction that recur across tasks.

options.text: Holding the finished documents from every run
options.feedback: Finished documents are outputs of particular tasks. Scripts contain code used to perform recurring operations.

options.text: Holding blank layouts for future documents
options.feedback: Blank layouts are reusable assets. Scripts instead supply executable steps.
